purpose: Manual record of the applied baseline, not a complete zone export or deployment tool. The separate markdown fallback is proposed and gated by merge, Pages and live verification.
scope: No Worker, Snippet, paid Markdown for Agents, API token, new secret, security change, analytics change or indexing approval.
exact_accept_policy: One Accept field with complete value text/markdown only. Mixed ranges, any q parameter, wildcard and ordinary browser Accept do not negotiate.
query_policy: Query is never rewritten. Directory negotiation requires an empty query. Explicit /404.html accepts only empty query, exact lang=uk, or exact lang=en (English). Every other query, including duplicate/encoded parameters, preserves ordinary HTML; no full URLSearchParams equivalence is claimed.
error_policy: Unknown paths retain origin404 and HTML error MIME. Content-Type changes require status200; combined policy headers require200. Unknown404 retains HTML meta noindex. Explicit /404.html and /404.html?lang=en are existing documents, not replacements for unknown routes. No /en/404.html exists.
cache_policy: Reserved Markdown-prefix bypass is intentionally installed first and last among any matching cache rules. Default rewritten URI separates variants, but this plan also bypasses Markdown edge caching. Preserve all HTML/versioned-static cache settings.
manual_apply_order: Export current rules/DNS and verify origin files, quotas and expressions.
Install five response-header rules in listed order; confirm existing Content-Signal policy does not conflict.
Enable three URL rewrites last; EN404 and generic404 have disjoint exact-query predicates because same-phase expressions see original fields.
Read back saved fields and complete acceptance matrix from the companion document.

rule.description: PISKOR exact Markdown request: public directory pages
rule.expression: (http.host eq "piskor.com.ua" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and len(http.request.headers["accept"]) eq 1 and http.request.headers["accept"][0] eq "text/markdown" and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/agent-markdown/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/agent-api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/agent-skills/") and http.request.uri.query eq ""

rule.description: PISKOR exact Markdown request: explicit English 404 document

rule.description: PISKOR exact Markdown request: explicit 404 document URL
rule.expression: (http.host eq "piskor.com.ua" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}) and len(http.request.headers["accept"]) eq 1 and http.request.headers["accept"][0] eq "text/markdown" and http.request.uri.path eq "/404.html" and http.request.uri.query in {"" "lang=uk"}

dns_proposal.name: _index._agents.piskor.com.ua
dns_proposal.meaning: Experimental organizational HTTPS discovery index pointing to homepage with real ARD/Agent Skills/API catalog links. Not an MCP/A2A server. Index payload schema is out of scope of the DNS-AID draft.
dns_proposal.dnssec: Enabled with explicit owner approval; registrar DS saved and independently validated on 2026-10-18. Existing DNS/mail records preserved. Revalidate before any later change.
dns_proposal.fallback: Leave pending if exact record cannot be expressed/validated; do not invent TXT encoding or endpoint claims.

rollback: Disable only these three request URL rewrites first.
Disable/remove only this plan's cache bypass and five response-header rules using saved IDs; restore previous order if needed.
Remove only the newly added DNS record if deployed; preserve all previous DNS/cache/security/consent/noindex settings.
Verify ordinary HTML, UA/EN, missing-route404, resource versions and noindex.

content_signals_policy.authorization: Explicit user policy for this release; search=yes does not remove or supersede page noindex.

origin_json_mime: Keep origin application/json on real JSON resources; verify it after deployment. No redundant JSON Content-Type transform.
